Title: TC_001: Verify CMS-configured bottom nav icon auto-plays Lottie animation on cold start app launch
Steps:
1. Force-kill the TPMA app
2. Launch app (cold start)
3. Observe bottom navigation bar
4. Identify the CMS-configured icon
Expected Result: The CMS-configured bottom nav icon (e.g. Favourites) begins playing its unselected Lottie auto-play animation immediately after app launch
Preconditions: User logged in; CMS configured with one animating icon (e.g. Favourites); app force-killed; cold start

Title: TC_002: Verify auto-play animation completes exactly 2 loops per default CMS configuration
Steps:
1. Cold start app with loop count configured as 2
2. Count animation loop cycles on the configured icon
3. Observe icon state after final loop
Expected Result: Animation plays exactly 2 complete loops then stops
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS loop count = 2; animation configured for one icon

Title: TC_003: Verify icon returns to static unselected state after auto-play animation completes
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Allow auto-play animation to complete all configured loops without tapping
3. Observe animating icon state
Expected Result: After animation completes, the icon displays in static unselected state (no ongoing Lottie animation)
Preconditions: Cold start; user does not interact with animating icon; animation allowed to complete

Title: TC_004: Verify auto-play does not replay within same app session after initial completion
Steps:
1. Complete auto-play animation on cold start
2. Navigate between bottom nav tabs
3. Background and foreground app without force-kill
4. Observe animating icon
Expected Result: Auto-play animation does NOT replay within the same app session after initial completion (per Scope: once per session)
Preconditions: User completed auto-play animation once in current session; session flag set

Title: TC_005: Verify tapping animating icon during animation stops Lottie immediately
Steps:
1. Cold start app and wait for animation to begin
2. Tap the animating icon before animation completes
3. Observe animation state at moment of tap
Expected Result: Lottie auto-play animation stops immediately upon user tap before completion
Preconditions: Cold start; auto-play animation in progress on configured icon

Title: TC_006: Verify selected state Lottie plays when user taps animating icon during animation
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Tap animating Live TV icon during auto-play
3. Observe icon visual state
Expected Result: Selected state Lottie animation plays for the tapped icon
Preconditions: Cold start; auto-play animation in progress

Title: TC_007: Verify app navigates to tapped tab when user taps animating icon during animation
Steps:
1. Cold start app from a different default tab
2. Tap animating My Account icon during animation
3. Observe screen content
Expected Result: App navigates to My Account tab content
Preconditions: Cold start; auto-play in progress on configured icon

Title: TC_008: Verify tapped animating icon remains in selected highlighted state after tap
Steps:
1. Tap animating icon during auto-play
2. Observe icon state after navigation completes
3. Wait 5 seconds without further interaction
Expected Result: Icon remains in selected (highlighted) state after tap during animation
Preconditions: User tapped animating icon during animation

Title: TC_009: Verify animation continues when user taps a non-animating bottom nav icon
Steps:
1. Cold start app and wait for Favourites animation to begin
2. Tap On Demand icon (non-animating)
3. Observe Favourites icon animation state
Expected Result: Auto-play animation on the configured icon continues playing until that icon is selected/tapped
Preconditions: Cold start; auto-play animation in progress on configured icon

Title: TC_010: Verify tapping non-animating icon navigates to that tab while animation continues on configured icon
Steps:
1. Start auto-play on Favourites
2. Tap Live TV icon
3. Verify current screen and Favourites icon animation
Expected Result: App navigates to Live TV tab; Favourites icon animation continues in bottom nav until Favourites is selected
Preconditions: Auto-play in progress; user taps different icon

Title: TC_011: Verify navigating to auto-play icon tab makes it selected
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Navigate to On Demand tab (animating icon)
3. Observe icon selected state
Expected Result: Auto-play configured icon displays in selected (highlighted) state when user navigates to its tab
Preconditions: Auto-play configured icon; user navigates to that tab via tap or programmatic navigation

Title: TC_012: Verify returning to auto-play icon tab after navigating away shows unselected state with no re-animation
Steps:
1. Complete or stop auto-play animation
2. Navigate to auto-play icon tab
3. Navigate to another bottom nav tab
4. Return to original auto-play icon tab
5. Observe icon state
Expected Result: Auto-play icon stays in unselected static state; no Lottie auto-play re-triggers on return
Preconditions: User previously visited auto-play icon tab; navigated to another tab; animation already completed or stopped

Title: TC_013: Verify Home icon is never animated regardless of CMS configuration
Steps:
1. Launch app on cold start
2. Observe Home icon in bottom navigation
3. Verify no Lottie auto-play on Home icon
Expected Result: Home icon is never animated; Home remains in selected state as hardcoded on FE
Preconditions: CMS may attempt to configure Home; Home icon hardcoded as always selected on FE

Title: TC_014: Verify only one bottom nav icon animates at a time per session
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Observe all bottom nav icons during auto-play window
3. Count icons with active Lottie animation

Preconditions: CMS configured with single animating icon

3. Observe bottom nav icons
Expected Result: Auto-play Lottie animation is skipped; icons display in normal static states without animation
Preconditions: Device accessibility setting prefers-reduced-motion = ON; CMS animation configured

Title: TC_022: Verify auto-play is gracefully skipped when CMS animation config is missing
Steps:
1. Configure CMS/bottom nav API to omit animation fields
2. Cold start app
3. Observe bottom nav behaviour
Expected Result: App gracefully skips auto-play; bottom nav displays fallback static icons without crash or error
Preconditions: CMS bottom nav response missing animation configuration fields

3. Reload page (cold start equivalent)

Steps:

Steps:

3. Observe bottom nav icons
Expected Result: Bottom nav icons are not animated on older app versions; users must update app to use feature
Preconditions: User on app version released before RT-1266 feature

Title: TC_027: Verify animation feature active only after updating to feature release app version

Title: TC_028: Verify CMS configuration attempting to animate Home icon is ignored
Steps:

2. Cold start app
3. Observe Home and other icons

Preconditions: CMS configured with Home as animating icon (invalid per FSD)

Title: TC_029: Verify session flag prevents auto-play on warm app resume within same session
Steps:
1. Complete auto-play on cold start
2. Background app (minimize)
3. Return to foreground
4. Observe bottom nav
Expected Result: Auto-play does not re-trigger on warm resume within same session after session flag is set (per Scope)
Preconditions: Auto-play completed once; app backgrounded without force-kill; same session

Title: TC_030: Verify force-kill and relaunch resets session and triggers auto-play again
Steps:
1. Complete auto-play in session
2. Force-kill app
3. Relaunch app (cold start)
4. Observe configured icon
Expected Result: Session flag resets on force-kill; auto-play Lottie animation triggers again on relaunch
Preconditions: User force-killed app after prior session with completed auto-play

Title: TC_031: Verify in-progress auto-play animation continues when app returns from background without force-kill
Steps:
1. Cold start app and begin auto-play
2. Minimize app mid-animation (do not force-kill)
3. Return app to foreground
4. Observe animation state
Expected Result: Auto-play animation continues/replays when app returns from background (per Scenario 4 and Assumptions)
Preconditions: Auto-play animation in progress; user minimizes app before animation completes

Title: TC_032: Verify animation replays when user backgrounds app after tapping animating icon mid-animation then returns
Steps:
1. Cold start and begin auto-play
2. Tap animating icon before completion
3. Navigate to another bottom nav tab
4. Background app
5. Return to foreground
6. Observe animating icon
Expected Result: Animation is replayed when app returns to foreground after tap-navigate-background sequence (per FSD Assumptions)
Preconditions: User tapped animating icon before completion; navigated to another tab; backgrounded; returned to foreground

Title: TC_033: Verify tap on animating icon during final loop frame stops animation correctly
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Wait until final loop of animation
3. Tap animating icon on last frame
4. Observe icon state
Expected Result: Animation stops immediately; selected state Lottie plays; icon remains selected
Preconditions: Auto-play on final loop of configured count

Title: TC_034: Verify tapping non-animating icon on last animation loop still allows animation to finish if animating icon not selected
Steps:
1. Cold start with animation on final loop
2. Tap non-animating icon
3. Observe animating icon until loops complete
Expected Result: Animation on configured icon completes its remaining loop(s) because animating icon was not selected
Preconditions: Auto-play on final loop; user taps different icon without selecting animating icon

Title: TC_035: Verify minimum loop count boundary (1 loop) when configured in CMS
Steps:

3. Count animation loops
Expected Result: Animation plays exactly 1 loop then stops and returns to static unselected state
Preconditions: CMS loop count = 1

Title: TC_036: Verify manual bottom nav navigation still works when prefers-reduced-motion skips auto-play
Steps:

2. Cold start app
3. Tap each bottom nav icon
4. Verify navigation
Expected Result: All bottom nav tabs remain fully navigable; selected/unselected states work correctly without auto-play
Preconditions: prefers-reduced-motion enabled; CMS animation configured

Steps:

2. Complete or observe auto-play
3. Update CMS to icon B without restarting app

Expected Result: Animation config does not hot-reload during active session; change applies only on next cold start/force-kill relaunch

Title: TC_038: Verify rotating animations across multiple icons per session is not implemented

2. Cold start app
3. Observe animation behaviour across session
Expected Result: Only one icon animates per session; no rotating animation sequence across multiple icons (out of scope)

Title: TC_039: Verify end-to-end cold start flow: CMS fetch → auto-play → completion → static state → session flag

1. Force-kill app
2. Launch app and monitor CMS fetch
3. Observe auto-play start
4. Allow animation to complete
5. Verify static unselected state
6. Relaunch within session without force-kill
Expected Result: CMS config fetched on launch; configured icon auto-plays configured loops; returns to static state; session flag prevents replay in same session
Preconditions: Logged-in user; valid CMS config; cold start

Title: TC_040: Verify end-to-end tap-during-animation flow: stop → selected Lottie → navigate → selected state
Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Tap animating icon mid-animation
3. Verify animation stop
4. Verify selected Lottie
5. Verify tab navigation
6. Verify persistent selected state
Expected Result: Complete tap-during-animation flow executes: animation stops, selected Lottie plays, navigation occurs, icon stays selected
Preconditions: Cold start with animation in progress

Steps:

Preconditions: CMS has multiple animation icon entries configured (future-proofing; no FE restriction)
